Players Committee card image of [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. While with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here, and, once per game, if about to be lost, may place in Used Pile. Immune to Fire Extinguisher and Restraining Bolt.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/r2d2.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 a5142dd] (12 May 2020). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
